firstPlayerRule: Choose a player at random to read the Base’s card A aloud. Each player then reads one of the following cards in turn.
clarifications: During play, players choose the order in which they resolve actions for each temporal unit; there is no fixed sequence of individual turns.
When changing locations, pass the Time Captain die to the player on the current captain’s left.
